race.comment: MAGICAL MOMENTS (7) has an imposing record on his home track and comes out of a strong Four Pillars Midway at Randwick after finishing third over 1500m at latest. Winkers go on today and has the class to overcome the awkward draw. MAYLEIGH (15) progressive mare starting to put it all together this time in. Back in trip with the 59.5kg for a dominant victory over 1400m at Hawkesbury in BM64 class. Maps well again and can run another big race. COMMON GOAL (6) scored a tough win second up at this level and looks well placed again with Keatings' claim. PERFECT PICTURE (8) returned from a spell two weeks ago to be beaten just 3 lengths into seventh over 1200m at Rosehill. Strips fitter and should be thereabouts.
